title: Harness of Minervini v2 market.snapshot response

exit_codes.0: A valid domain envelope was emitted; its status may still be partial, unavailable, or needs_input.
exit_codes.2: The request or arguments were invalid; stdout contains a needs_input error envelope.
exit_codes.3: An unexpected internal contract failure occurred; stdout contains an unavailable error envelope.

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

leader_limit.description: Maximum first-party RS leader observations, from 1 through 100.

no_cache.description: Bypass both provider-cache reads and writes for this invocation.

trade_traction.description: Whether the user's recent pilot trades confirm the observed environment; required for a favorable regime.

limitations: QQQ versus 21 EMA is context: an index that has switched off refuses a favorable regime, and a switch that is on does not produce one.

Finviz publishes only a live page, so breadth is a current observation standing in for the completed session; no registered threshold reads it, so it never gates a regime word, and the envelope discloses how long after the close it was read.
Breadth is refused outright while a regular session is open, and an uncaptured historical page can never be reconstructed.
Group membership comes from a mutable current classification, so a snapshot taken against a past session reads no membership at all and says so rather than attaching today's taxonomy to it.
A missing source remains unavailable; no web or proxy number replaces it.
x-capability-contract.output: A transparent signal vector, a regime judgment that names which signals carried it and which stood beside it as context, ranked groups, leader readings, missing evidence, and source metadata. Each ranked leader is read from its own completed bars -- distance from a 52-week high, whether it prints on the 52-week-low list, and how deep its correction from the last peak has run -- and each reading cites the claim it was taken under. A group is read through the ranked leaders a current classification placed inside it, so its counts are a sample of the market leaders and never a census of the group, and the sample is published beside every count.

status_meanings.needs_input: Trade traction is absent even though provider evidence may exist.
status_meanings.ok: All requested evidence is available, including trade traction.
status_meanings.partial: Some independent sources or breadth sections are unavailable, or an index history stopped before the requested session.

x-capability-contract.summary: Measure market regime, breadth, sector and industry leadership, and leading-stock evidence without forcing a bullish score.
